title: Preston Love and C. Q. Price
summary: Greene says Preston idolized Earl Warren and that C. Q. Price was a third alto from Buffalo.

blocks.x: How was Preston Love as the first alto?
Well, Preston was -- his idol was Earl Warren.
Yeah. He told you that, didn't he Stan?
His idol was Earl Warren, and he sounded good. He fitted. He did very good with the band.
Well, could he play, more or less, like Earl?
Yeah. He could. He sounded quite a bit like him.
So -- what -- you're looking at the discography -- what --
What about Charlie Price? Where was he from? Alto. Charlie Price? Or, C. Q. Price?
C.Q. Price. C.Q. was from Buffalo.
Buffalo, New York. He was like a third alto. Yeah. He was a third alto. And, he wrote, also. He writes.
But, he sounded good. He sounded good with the band. I didn't know too much about his background, you know, more or less, but --
